title: Classy, Cozy, Close to Downtown!
description:
New modern decor with a Nashville feel. Fully stocked with toiletries,  complementary coffee/tea station,  condiments, cookware,  & laundry soap etc. A great place to stay when having a Nashville style get away  with friends or family, for a memorable time. Heater/Air conditioning settings for each floor, 3 flat screens all with complementary Netflix, Disney +, prime, and Apple TV.  Please note- no parties or events aloud. Absolutely no smoking of any kind.

The space
Super close to downtown, 4 min drive to Nissan stadium (1 mile), 2 min walk to grocery store, the best top eats, and famous restaurants in Nashville, available on Uber eats & Doordash from this location. Including: Hattie B’s hot chicken (Justin Timberlakes favorite), Rolf & Daughters, Emmy squared, Juicy seafood (crab), Five Daughter’s bakery, and more! Please note that parties  & events are not allowed. Absolutely no smoking of any kind aloud.

Guest access
Pull up bar & weights on 3rd floor. Patio great for sunrise & sunsets, with a cup of coffee, or glass of wine.

Other things to note
Please no food or drinks on couch, or shoes on the carpet in living room. No smoking of any kind aloud, smoke odor removal fees will be applied.
